messages.subject: interaction.plot features
parts:
Hi all,
I am making some interaction plots for several response variables,
measured at several time points.
I want the same display for all variables. For example, if I plot
average mean of Y1 across time for group1 and group 2, I have a dashed
line for group 1 and a solid line for group2.
For variable y2, since the values for y2 are higher in group 2, then
the dashed line is now for group2 and solid line for group 1.
I just want to have all group 1 graphed as a dashed line for all
variables (y1, y2, y3), and group 2 as a solid line or viceversa
regardless of the value of the means.
Here is the command I am using for each individual response variable
Y:
interaction.plot(Time, factor(Group), Y1, ylim=c(40, 500), lty=c(1,
3),fun = function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), ylab="Mean of Y1",
xlab="time", lwd=3, trace.label="Condition")
Many thanks in advance!
Dana
